title: Microsoft Purview: analyse endpoint DLP evidence files in Data Security Investigations
notes: claim 83: severity blocker on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the search instructions omit the Summary navigation step needed to reach the Search tab. The access rationale also incorrectly excludes Reviewers, who can read investigation data and run analysis. The roadmap facts, billing requirements and three tabulated portal routes are supported.

claims.where: Open questions: general availability or preview
claims.claim: The Learn search page does not label its endpoint section as preview or generally available.
claims.quote: Searched: Data Security Investigations endpoint DLP launch alert endpoint filter search date users; evidence collection PowerShell Microsoft storage. Read the search section, which has no preview label; dlp-copy-matched-items-learn explicitly calls the search option preview.
claims.fix: Replace the second Open questions bullet with 'The roadmap lists General Availability and Preview, and the search page has no preview label; the evidence collection overview still calls the DSI endpoint search option preview.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-copy-matched-items-learn.

claims.claim: The evidence collection getting-started page gives no managed-store retention period.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft-managed evidence retention Purview; read getting-started and dlp-copy-matched-items-learn. Getting-started has no managed retention period; the overview gives a 180-day maximum and a separate 30 days on Purview/180 days on Defender XDR row.
claims.fix: Remove the third Open questions bullet. Its narrow statement about the getting-started page is true, but the linked overview publishes retention information at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-copy-matched-items-learn#storing-evidence-when-sensitive-information-is-detected.

claims.quote: Searched: Data Security Investigations add to scope rate compute units. Read billing and search; inspected scope and AI-analysis excerpts. Billing lists size of data and extracted text as cost variables, not a separate endpoint-evidence rate.

claims.claim: Only admins and investigators with DSI roles see or use the capability.
claims.quote: Only Data Security Investigations Administrators, Investigators, and Reviewers have access to this data in your organization.
claims.fix: Replace the impact rationale with 'Low. Investigation data is accessible to Data Security Investigations Administrators, Investigators and Reviewers; only Admins and Investigators can create searches and add items.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/data-security-investigations-privacy-faq and the existing permissions source.
